home.heroTitle:
A World of Comfort.
A Sense of Belonging.
home.heroText: Discover refined hospitality and exceptional comfort in the heart of Abuja.
home.introTitle:
More Than a Stay.
A Place to Belong.
home.introText:
DE DON was conceived as a residence first and a hotel second: a house where the pace slows the moment you arrive, where your preferences are remembered rather than requested, and where every detail is considered so that you never have to think about it.

Whether you are in Abuja for a summit, a celebration or simply to rest, our role is the same — to give you the quiet confidence of being looked after, beautifully.
home.introSignature: The art of hospitality, practised with care.
home.roomsText: Considered spaces for rest and work, each with its own rhythm of light, texture and calm.
home.diningText: Seasonal ingredients, generous hospitality and rooms designed for long conversations — from an early breakfast before the day's meetings to a late, unhurried dinner.
home.eventsText: From board meetings that demand discretion to celebrations that deserve ceremony, our events team plans every element with precision — so you can be present for the moment itself.
home.locationTitle:
In the Heart
of the Capital
home.locationText: Abuja is a city of wide avenues, landmark architecture and a skyline framed by Aso Rock. DE DON places you within easy reach of the capital's government, diplomatic and business districts.

dining.intro: Food is where hospitality becomes personal. Our kitchens cook with respect for the ingredient and for the guest — honest flavours, careful technique and service that reads the table.

venues.name: The Aso Room
venues.description: Our signature all-day dining room: West African flavours cooked with modern technique alongside international classics, served beneath soft brass light with views over the garden terrace.

venues.name: The Gold Lounge
venues.description: A low-lit lounge for an aperitif after the day's meetings, a quiet conversation or a nightcap — with a cocktail list built around Nigerian botanicals and an extensive wine cellar.

venues.name: In-Room Dining
venues.cuisine: Full menu from The Aso Room
venues.description: Selected dishes from The Aso Room and a dedicated night menu, served in the privacy of your room or suite at any hour.

signatureDishes.name: Smoked Jollof with Guinea Fowl

signatureDishes.name: Suya-Spiced Beef Tenderloin

about.story:
DE DON was founded on a simple idea: that Nigeria's capital deserved a hotel that felt less like an institution and more like a private residence — a place where a visiting minister, a returning family and a first-time traveller would all feel equally at home.

From its address in the Central Business District, the hotel brings together considered design, Nigerian warmth and the quiet precision of international hospitality. (Demo story — replace with the hotel's verified history.)
about.philosophy: We believe luxury is not a display but a feeling — the feeling of being expected, understood and at ease. It lives in small things: a name remembered, a room prepared just so, a question answered before it is asked.
